name: workout
description: A mobile-first workout tracker for planning routines, logging sets, and tracking strength progress.

scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w edge
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w edge
scripts.test: npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w edge
scripts.check: npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:validate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run package -w edge && npm run smoke:health && git diff --check
